example_sentences.de: Am Morgen ist der Verkehr in der Stadt sehr stark.
example_sentences.en: In the morning the traffic in the city is very heavy.

example_sentences.de: Wegen des Verkehrs komme ich zehn Minuten später.
example_sentences.en: Because of the traffic I will arrive ten minutes later.

cloze.de: Auf der Autobahn war heute kaum ___.
cloze.en: There was hardly any traffic on the motorway today.

words.notes: No plural. On the road it means traffic; «öffentlicher Verkehr» means public transport.
words.mnemonic: ver-KEHR-en means to turn around – Verkehr is the endless turning of cars through town.
words.germany_context: Radio stations read out Verkehrsmeldungen every half hour, and «Stau auf der A9» is a daily sentence. Navi apps also warn about Blitzer.

example_sentences.de: Wegen eines Ausfalls fährt heute kein Zug nach Köln.
example_sentences.en: Because of a cancellation no train is going to Cologne today.

example_sentences.de: Die App zeigt alle Verspätungen und Ausfälle an.
example_sentences.en: The app shows all delays and cancellations.

cloze.de: Der ___ der S-Bahn wurde erst kurz vorher angekündigt.
cloze.en: The cancellation of the suburban train was only announced shortly beforehand.

words.notes: For trains the compound «Zugausfall» is usual; in speech people simply say «Der Zug fällt aus».
words.mnemonic: aus + fallen: the train falls out of the timetable.
words.germany_context: Boards and the DB Navigator app mark a cancelled train «Zug fällt aus». If you arrive over 60 minutes late you can claim 25 % of the fare back under the Fahrgastrechte.

example_sentences.de: Im Nahverkehr gilt das Deutschlandticket überall.
example_sentences.en: The Deutschlandticket is valid everywhere on local public transport.

example_sentences.de: Der Nahverkehr in München funktioniert wirklich gut.
example_sentences.en: Local public transport in Munich really works well.

cloze.de: Bus, Tram und S-Bahn gehören alle zum ___.
cloze.en: Bus, tram and suburban train all belong to local public transport.

words.notes: Officially abbreviated ÖPNV (öffentlicher Personennahverkehr). The opposite is «Fernverkehr» – ICE and IC trains.
words.mnemonic: nah = near, Verkehr = traffic: transport for near journeys.
words.germany_context: The Deutschlandticket (about 58 € a month in 2025) covers the entire German Nahverkehr but never the Fernverkehr trains ICE, IC or EC.

example_sentences.de: Unser Wagen steht schon in der Garage.
example_sentences.en: Our car is already in the garage.

example_sentences.de: Ihr Sitzplatz ist in Wagen zwölf.
example_sentences.en: Your seat is in coach twelve.

cloze.de: Der Zug hat heute nur sechs ___.
cloze.en: The train only has six carriages today.

words.notes: Plural is identical to the singular. On the road it is a slightly formal word for Auto; on the train it means the carriage.
words.mnemonic: Wagen is the English «wagon» – same old word.
words.germany_context: DB tickets and reservations are printed as «Wagen 12, Platz 61», and the Wagenstandsanzeiger on the platform shows where each Wagen will stop.

example_sentences.de: Wegen des Streiks fahren heute keine Busse.
example_sentences.en: Because of the strike no buses are running today.

example_sentences.de: Der Streik dauert noch bis Freitagmorgen.
example_sentences.en: The strike lasts until Friday morning.

cloze.de: Bei der Bahn gibt es nächste Woche wieder einen ___.
cloze.en: There will be another strike at the railway next week.

words.notes: The verb is «streiken». A short warning strike is a «Warnstreik», a rail strike a «Bahnstreik».
words.mnemonic: Streik sounds like «strike» – the same word borrowed into German.
words.germany_context: Rail, bus and airport strikes are frequent in Germany. During a Bahnstreik the DB runs a Notfahrplan and lets you use your ticket on another day free of charge.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Umweltplakette darfst du nicht in die Innenstadt fahren.
example_sentences.en: Without an emissions sticker you may not drive into the city centre.

example_sentences.de: Die Umweltplakette klebt vorne an der Scheibe.
example_sentences.en: The emissions sticker is stuck on the front windscreen.

cloze.de: Die grüne ___ habe ich beim TÜV bekommen.
cloze.en: I got the green emissions sticker at the vehicle inspection centre.

words.notes: In practice always the green one; people just say «die grüne Plakette».
words.mnemonic: Umwelt (environment) + Plakette (badge) – a badge that says your car is clean enough.
words.germany_context: Most German cities have an Umweltzone that only cars with a green Umweltplakette may enter. It costs about 6–20 € at a Werkstatt, the TÜV or the Zulassungsstelle; driving in without one is a 100 € fine.

example_sentences.de: Der Fernbus nach Prag ist viel billiger als der Zug.
example_sentences.en: The long-distance bus to Prague is much cheaper than the train.

example_sentences.de: Wir fahren am Wochenende mit dem Fernbus nach Hamburg.
example_sentences.en: At the weekend we are taking the long-distance bus to Hamburg.

cloze.de: Am ZOB halten alle ___ nach Berlin.
cloze.en: All long-distance buses to Berlin stop at the central bus station.

words.notes: «Fern-» means long-distance and is the opposite of «Nah-». Buses leave from the ZOB, the zentraler Omnibusbahnhof.
words.mnemonic: fern = far away, so a Fernbus goes far.
words.germany_context: FlixBus dominates the German long-distance bus market: cheap and slow, with departures from the ZOB rather than the Hauptbahnhof. Luggage is included, seats can be reserved for a small Aufpreis.

example_sentences.de: Ich suche eine Mitfahrgelegenheit nach Frankfurt.
example_sentences.en: I am looking for a ride share to Frankfurt.

example_sentences.de: Mit einer Mitfahrgelegenheit spart man viel Geld.
example_sentences.en: You save a lot of money with a ride share.

cloze.de: Hast du für das Wochenende schon eine ___ gefunden?
cloze.en: Have you already found a ride share for the weekend?

words.notes: Short forms: «Mitfahrt» or «MFG». The verb is «mitfahren», to ride along.
words.mnemonic: mit + fahren + Gelegenheit = an opportunity to ride along.
words.germany_context: BlaBlaCar is the main platform in Germany. Drivers may legally only ask for a share of the costs, so a seat from Berlin to Hamburg often costs under 20 €.

example_sentences.de: Ich muss noch tanken, bevor wir losfahren.
example_sentences.en: I still have to fill up before we set off.

example_sentences.de: An dieser Tankstelle tanke ich immer.
example_sentences.en: I always fill up at this petrol station.

cloze.de: Wo hast du gestern Abend ___?
cloze.en: Where did you fill up yesterday evening?

words.notes: Works without an object: «Ich tanke.» You can add the fuel: «Diesel tanken», «voll tanken».
words.mnemonic: Tank + -en: you put something into the tank.
words.germany_context: German petrol stations are self-service: fill up first, note the Säulennummer and pay inside. Prices swing by 15 cents a day and are usually lowest in the evening.

example_sentences.de: Hinter der Kurve steht ein Blitzer.
example_sentences.en: There is a speed camera behind the bend.

example_sentences.de: Der Blitzer hat mich leider erwischt.
example_sentences.en: Unfortunately the speed camera caught me.

cloze.de: In dieser Straße gibt es seit Januar einen neuen ___.
cloze.en: There has been a new speed camera in this street since January.

words.notes: Colloquial but used by everyone. The verb is «blitzen»: «Ich wurde geblitzt» means I got caught by the camera.
words.mnemonic: Blitz = flash of lightning – the Blitzer flashes you.
words.germany_context: Mobile Blitzer often sit in parked vans at the roadside. The Bußgeldbescheid with your photo arrives by post weeks later; from 21 km/h over the limit you also collect a Punkt in Flensburg.

example_sentences.de: Mein Auto muss dieses Jahr zum TÜV.
example_sentences.en: My car has to go for its inspection this year.

example_sentences.de: Der TÜV hat drei kleine Mängel gefunden.
example_sentences.en: The inspection found three small defects.

cloze.de: Ohne gültigen ___ darfst du nicht mehr fahren.
cloze.en: Without a valid inspection you are no longer allowed to drive.

words.notes: Strictly the name of the testing organisation, but everyone uses it for the test itself. Pronounced like «tüff».
words.mnemonic: TÜV = Technischer Überwachungsverein – der Verein, so it is masculine.
words.germany_context: Every car needs the Hauptuntersuchung («TÜV») every two years, a brand new one after three. The coloured sticker on the rear number plate shows the month and year it expires; being late brings a fine and points in Flensburg.

example_sentences.de: Der linke Reifen hat zu wenig Luft.
example_sentences.en: The left tyre has too little air.

example_sentences.de: Im Winter brauchst du andere Reifen.
example_sentences.en: In winter you need different tyres.

cloze.de: Im Oktober wechseln wir immer die ___.
cloze.en: In October we always change the tyres.

words.notes: Plural is the same as the singular. The two standard sets are Sommerreifen and Winterreifen.
words.mnemonic: A Reif is a ring or hoop – a Reifen is the rubber hoop on the wheel.
words.germany_context: Winter tyres with the Alpine snowflake symbol are compulsory in snow and ice. The rule of thumb is «von O bis O» – from Oktober to Ostern; driving on summer tyres in snow costs 60 € and a point.

example_sentences.de: Wir hatten eine Panne auf der Autobahn.
example_sentences.en: We had a breakdown on the motorway.

example_sentences.de: Nach der Panne mussten wir zwei Stunden warten.
example_sentences.en: After the breakdown we had to wait two hours.

cloze.de: Bei einer ___ stellst du sofort das Warndreieck auf.
cloze.en: In case of a breakdown you set up the warning triangle immediately.

words.notes: Also used for any small mishap: «eine technische Panne», «eine Panne im System».
words.mnemonic: Panne comes from French «panne» – the car has gone out of service.
words.germany_context: If you break down, put on the Warnweste, place the Warndreieck 100 metres behind the car and call the ADAC Pannenhilfe on 22 22 22. Both the vest and the triangle are legally required in every car.

example_sentences.de: Vor der Ampel musst du früh bremsen.
example_sentences.en: You have to brake early before the traffic light.

example_sentences.de: Er bremste, weil ein Kind auf die Straße lief.
example_sentences.en: He braked because a child ran onto the road.

cloze.de: Bei Regen ___ man besser vorsichtig.
cloze.en: In the rain it is better to brake carefully.

words.notes: The noun is «die Bremse». «Abbremsen» means to slow down, «ausbremsen» to cut somebody off.
words.mnemonic: Bremse sounds like «brakes» – press it and you slow down.

example_sentences.de: Auf der Autobahn überholt man immer links.
example_sentences.en: On the motorway you always overtake on the left.

example_sentences.de: Ein großer Lkw hat uns gerade überholt.
example_sentences.en: A big lorry just overtook us.

cloze.de: In dieser Kurve darfst du auf keinen Fall ___.
cloze.en: You must never overtake on this bend.

words.notes: Inseparable prefix über-, so the participle has no ge-: «hat überholt». Stress is on «hol».
words.mnemonic: über = over: you go over to the other lane and past the car.
words.germany_context: Overtaking on the right is forbidden in Germany and costs 100 € plus a point in Flensburg. After passing you must move back to the right lane – the Rechtsfahrgebot.

example_sentences.de: Das Nummernschild ist ganz schmutzig.
example_sentences.en: The number plate is completely dirty.

example_sentences.de: Auf dem Nummernschild steht ein M für München.
example_sentences.en: There is an M for Munich on the number plate.

cloze.de: Kannst du dir bitte das ___ von dem Auto merken?
cloze.en: Can you please remember the number plate of that car?

words.notes: The official term is «das Kennzeichen»; both words are common in everyday speech.
words.mnemonic: Nummer + Schild = the sign with the number. Schild is neuter, so das Nummernschild.
words.germany_context: German plates start with the town or district code: B for Berlin, M for München, HH for Hamburg, F for Frankfurt. You get them at the Zulassungsstelle and can reserve a personal combination online.

example_sentences.de: Für die Zulassung brauchst du deinen Ausweis und die Versicherungsnummer.
example_sentences.en: For the vehicle registration you need your ID and the insurance number.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Zulassung darf das Auto nicht auf die Straße.
example_sentences.en: Without registration the car is not allowed on the road.

cloze.de: Die ___ meines Wagens habe ich gestern endlich erledigt.
cloze.en: I finally sorted out the registration of my car yesterday.

words.notes: From «zulassen», to admit or license. The office is the Zulassungsstelle, the papers are Fahrzeugschein and Fahrzeugbrief.
words.mnemonic: Nouns in -ung are always feminine: die Zulassung, die Verspätung, die Wohnung.
words.germany_context: You register a car at the Kfz-Zulassungsstelle of your district. Bring your Personalausweis, Meldebescheinigung, the eVB number from your insurer and your IBAN for the Kfz-Steuer, and book the Termin weeks in advance.

example_sentences.de: Vor der Schule gilt eine Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung von 30.
example_sentences.en: In front of the school there is a speed limit of 30.

example_sentences.de: Auf vielen Abschnitten gibt es keine Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung.
example_sentences.en: On many sections there is no speed limit.

cloze.de: Achte auf die ___, hier wird oft geblitzt.
cloze.en: Watch the speed limit, there are often speed cameras here.

words.notes: Everyday short form: «das Tempolimit». Limits are shown in km/h on round signs with a red rim.
words.mnemonic: Geschwindigkeit (speed) + Begrenzung (limitation); -ung endings are feminine.
words.germany_context: The default is 50 km/h in town and 100 km/h outside. Parts of the Autobahn have no limit, only a Richtgeschwindigkeit of 130 km/h, but mobile Blitzer are everywhere and a photo arrives by post.

example_sentences.de: Leg bitte die Parkscheibe ins Auto.
example_sentences.en: Please put the parking disc in the car.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Parkscheibe bekommst du hier ein Bußgeld.
example_sentences.en: Without a parking disc you get a fine here.

cloze.de: Ich habe vergessen, die ___ einzustellen.
cloze.en: I forgot to set the parking disc.

words.notes: You turn it to the next half hour after arriving and lay it visibly on the dashboard.
words.mnemonic: parken + Scheibe (disc) – the little blue disc behind the windscreen.
words.germany_context: A blue sign with a parking-disc symbol means free parking for a limited time, often one or two hours. Forgetting the disc costs 20–30 € and every German petrol station sells one for about 1 €.

example_sentences.de: In der Stadt nutze ich lieber Carsharing.
example_sentences.en: In the city I prefer to use car sharing.

example_sentences.de: Carsharing ist günstiger als ein eigenes Auto.
example_sentences.en: Car sharing is cheaper than your own car.

cloze.de: Für kurze Wege in der Stadt lohnt sich ___.
cloze.en: For short trips in the city, car sharing is worth it.

words.notes: A loanword, but treated like any German noun: neuter and capitalised. No plural.
words.mnemonic: English words ending in -ing become neuter in German: das Carsharing, das Meeting, das Training.
words.germany_context: Providers like Share Now, Miles, Cambio and Stadtmobil operate in most German cities. You register once with your Führerschein and Personalausweis and then open the car with an app; fuel and parking in the Heimatzone are included.

example_sentences.de: Fußgänger haben am Zebrastreifen Vorrang.
example_sentences.en: Pedestrians have right of way at the zebra crossing.

example_sentences.de: Ein Fußgänger wartet an der Kreuzung auf Grün.
example_sentences.en: A pedestrian is waiting at the crossroads for the green light.

cloze.de: Als ___ darfst du hier nicht über die Gleise gehen.
cloze.en: As a pedestrian you may not walk across the tracks here.

words.notes: Female form: die Fußgängerin. The plural is identical to the singular.
words.mnemonic: Fuß + Gänger: someone who goes on foot.
words.germany_context: Germans wait at a red pedestrian light even on an empty street, especially when children are watching. Crossing on red costs 5 € and earns you a lecture from strangers.
